About us

Pliant is a modular B2B payments platform that combines commercial card issuing, payment accounts, FX, and spend management in one system - adapting to existing setups rather than requiring customers to replace them.

Businesses across industries such as travel, e-commerce, and insurance use Pliant to manage complex payment workflows with cards, backed by credit lines Pliant underwrites itself.

Fintechs and software platforms embed Pliant's payment infrastructure into their own products, from API-based Cards-as-a-Service to fully white-label solutions. Banks use Pliant's Card & Spend OS, the customer-facing interface, on their own infrastructure to run card programs.

Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Berlin, Pliant serves 5,000+ businesses and 40+ partners across Europe and the United States. A principal member of Visa and Mastercard, Pliant issues commercial cards in 13 currencies across 32 countries - under its own European e-money license and with licensed partners in the UK and US.

About the role

Member Management is the trust layer of Pliant. The team owns identity, authentication, access and permissions, the full member lifecycle, and the multi-region tenant structure underneath it all. As Pliant moves up-market and works with banks and larger partners, this area becomes increasingly important: security reviews and vendor assessments depend heavily on how well we handle identity and access.

As (Senior) Product Manager - Member Management (m/f/d), you will own how members - and increasingly AI agents - access Pliant. Your scope covers authentication (passkeys, eIDs, enterprise IDPs, SSO), the permissions model, the joiner-mover-leaver lifecycle, and multi-tenant, multi-region identity for partners and banks. The main challenge is combining bank-grade security with an access experience that stays simple for members.

This is a hands-on, platform-heavy role for someone who enjoys structuring ambiguous problems, working closely with engineers on identity topics, and building capabilities that other teams at Pliant rely on.

What you'll do

• Own strategy, roadmap, and execution for Member Management: identity, authentication, access and permissions, the member lifecycle, and tenant management

• Advance passwordless, adaptive authentication (passkeys, eIDs, enterprise IDPs, SSO) and step-up verification for sensitive actions

• Build multi-tenant, multi-region identity that lets partners and banks launch quickly and lets members move easily between tenants and organizations

• Automate the member lifecycle end to end: HRIS sync plus just-in-time provisioning, so joiners, movers, and leavers always have the right access

• Work with Security, Compliance, and Engineering to meet the authentication, access-control, resilience, and audit bar that banks and regulated institutions require

• Design the permissions and entitlements model that other Pliant domains build on

• Prepare the platform for AI agents as governed members: verifiable identity, scoped permissions and limits, and a full audit trail

What you'll bring

• 5+ years in product management or a related role, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech, identity/security, or platform-heavy environments

• Experience with identity and access - authentication, SSO and IDPs, permissions and RBAC, provisioning - or a strong interest in getting deep into the domain

• Strong technical fluency: comfortable discussing auth flows, multi-tenancy, integrations, and system-design trade-offs with engineers

• Ability to work through ambiguity, create structure, and make sound decisions without perfect information

• Familiarity with fintech trust and compliance requirements (e.g. PSD2) is a strong plus

• High ownership, bias for action, and clear cross-functional communication
